questiondescription.text:
Sets: empty, finite and infinite sets

Grade 12 CBE Core and Essential 1.1 (a): Classify sets given by a rule or a description as empty, finite or infinite.

Core and Essential

This question is adapted from the revision exercise on page 126, question 6 of School Mathematics Project, SMP Book 1 (Metric), Cambridge University Press, 1969: deciding how many members a described set has; every set is new, with traps such as {0} and very large finite sets.

INNODEMS CBC Grade 12 Mathematics, first draft by Ben Davies, 2026. Aligned to the KICD Senior School Curriculum Design, Core and Essential Mathematics Grade 12 (draft).
